title: Cloud Download In-Place Refresh
notes: Keeps users inside the open Drill Log after downloading a cloud revision instead of returning to the MITHRIL landing screen.
Refreshes Drill Log pages, page navigation, cached rendering, and the visible canvas immediately after the cloud data is applied.
Shows a clear loaded-successfully confirmation with the cloud revision number.
Keeps the Shot Diagram inside its existing wrapper while refreshing its inner document after a cloud download.
Adds the active cloud-sync helper version to the Cloud Sync window for easier cache troubleshooting.
Preserves private Firebase sign-in, revisions, device names, local/offline saving, and all m39.8 and m39.7 workflows.
